# Manual Test Cases — Android SMS Compliance Filter

<!-- Written By Bill Roth (bill.roth@gmail.com) — Generated by Claude — 2026-07-30 -->
<!-- Offered under the BSD 3-Clause license. Copyright (c) 2026 Bill Roth. -->

These cases cover behaviour that automated tests cannot reach: real SMS delivery, real contacts,
real short codes, and the Android permission model. Run them on a **physical phone with an active
SIM**. An emulator cannot faithfully reproduce short-code addressing, multi-part message
concatenation, or alphanumeric sender IDs.

## Before you start

1. Install the debug build: `./gradlew installDebug`
2. Complete the onboarding wizard, granting all permissions.
3. Have a second phone, or an online SMS service, available to send test messages from.
4. For cases involving contacts, save the sending number to Google Contacts first.

To reset between runs: **Settings → Apps → SMS Filter → Storage → Clear storage**, which wipes the
database, preferences, and the stored HubSpot token.

## Cases

| # | Sender | Message | Expected | Pass/Fail |
|---|--------|---------|----------|-----------|
| 1 | Known Google Contact | Any message | Ignored — no reply, no notification. Log shows "Ignored: Known Google Contact" | |
| 2 | Known HubSpot contact | Any message | Ignored. Log shows "Ignored: Known HubSpot Contact" | |
| 3 | Unknown | `Hello, reply STOP to unsubscribe` | No alert — STOP is not alone on the last line | |
| 4 | Unknown | `Hello` newline `STOP` | Alert — last-line match, reply "stop" sent | |
| 5 | Unknown | `Thanks` newline `stop` | Alert — case-insensitive last-line match | |
| 6 | Unknown | Contains stop-list word `promo` | Ignored. Log shows "Ignored: Matched Stop List word 'promo'" | |
| 7 | Unknown | `stop2stop this deal` | Alert — stop2stop match anywhere, reply "stop" | |
| 8 | Unknown | `end2end encryption rocks` | Alert — end2end match anywhere, reply "end" | |
| 9 | Unknown | `Postop care instructions` newline `Call us` | No alert — "stop" embedded in a word on a non-last line | |
| 10 | Unknown | Empty message | No alert | |
| 11 | Unknown | `Hello` newline `STOP`, Beep On Opt-Out **enabled** | Alert, reply "stop", configured sound plays | |
| 12 | Unknown | `Hello` newline `STOP`, Beep On Opt-Out **disabled** | Alert and reply "stop" with no sound | |
| 13 | N/A | Switch app language to Spanish in Settings | Every screen displays in Spanish | |
| 14 | Unknown short code (e.g. 89887) | `Hello` newline `STOP` | Alert — reply "stop" sent to the raw short-code address, not an E.164 form | |
| 15 | Same sender as #14, second message within 24 hours | `Hello` newline `STOP` | Alert and log "Reply skipped: cooldown" — no second reply sent | |
| 16 | Unknown | `Hello` newline `STOP`, Auto-Reply toggle **off** | Alert and log "Reply skipped: dry run" — no SMS sent | |
| 17 | Alphanumeric sender (e.g. PROMO) | `Hello` newline `STOP` | Alert and log "Reply skipped: alphanumeric sender" — no SMS sent | |
| 18 | Unknown | `Hello` newline `STOP` received mid-wizard, before Done is pressed | Nothing — no reply, no notification, no log entry (onboarding gate) | |
| 19 | Unknown | `Hello` newline `STOP` with READ_CONTACTS denied | Alert and reply "stop" — no crash; contacts lookup returns "not found" without querying | |

## Notes on specific cases

**Case 14 (short codes)** is the case most likely to reveal a real bug, because a short code cannot
be normalized to E.164. Confirm on the receiving end that the reply arrived at the exact short code,
not at a rewritten number.

**Case 15 (cooldown)** requires the two messages to be within 24 hours of each other. To retest
without waiting, clear storage and start over.

**Case 18 (onboarding gate)** is awkward to stage but important: it proves the app cannot send an
SMS on the user's behalf before they have finished setup. Uninstall, reinstall, advance to the
permissions step and grant them, then send the message *before* pressing Done on the final step.

**Case 19 (contacts denied)** requires revoking contacts access in system settings while leaving the
other permissions granted.
